guitar.evidence: Puddle of Mudd guitarists used Gibson Les Pauls/SGs typical of early-2000s post-grunge, but no singularly iconic documented instrument.

tone.target: gritty alt-rock crunch with slight fuzz edge
tone.profile: gritty alt-rock crunch with slight fuzz edge
tone.summary: A tight, crunchy signal chain using an OD boost for grit, followed by a classic UK amp model, paired with a 4x12 cab, finished with light reverb.

rig.name: Puddle Of Mudd - Blurry - Valeton GP-180
